1.web: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
1.asv: My son, keep my words, And lay up my commandments with thee.

2.web: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
2.asv: Keep my commandments and live; And my law as the apple of thine eye.

3.web: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
3.asv: Bind them upon thy fingers; Write them upon the tablet of thy heart.

4.web: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
4.asv: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; And call understandingthy kinswoman:

5.web: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
5.asv: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, From the foreigner that flattereth with her words.

6.web: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
6.asv: For at the window of my house I looked forth through my lattice;

7.web: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
7.asv: And I beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, A young man void of understanding,

8.web: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,
8.asv: Passing through the street near her corner; And he went the way to her house,

9.web: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
9.asv: In the twilight, in the evening of the day, In the middle of the night and in the darkness.

10.web: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
10.asv: And, behold, there met him a woman With the attire of a harlot, and wily of heart.

11.web: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
11.asv: (She is clamorous and wilful; Her feet abide not in her house:

12.web: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
12.asv: Now she is in the streets, now in the broad places, And lieth in wait at every corner.)

13.web: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
13.asv: So she caught him, and kissed him, Andwith an impudent face she said unto him:

14.web: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. This day I have paid my vows.
14.asv: Sacrifices of peace-offerings are with me; This day have I paid my vows.

15.web: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
15.asv: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, Diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

16.web: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
16.asv: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, With striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

17.web: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
17.asv: I have perfumed my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

18.web: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
18.asv: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning; Let us solace ourselves with loves.

19.web: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
19.asv: For the man is not at home; He is gone a long journey:

20.web: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
20.asv: He hath taken a bag of money with him; He will come home at the full moon.

21.web: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
21.asv: With her much fair speech she causeth him to yield; With the flattering of her lips she forceth him along.

22.web: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
22.asv: He goeth after her straightway, As an ox goeth to the slaughter, Or asone infetters to the correction of the fool;

23.web: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
23.asv: Till an arrow strike through his liver; As a bird hasteth to the snare, And knoweth not that it is for his life.

24.web: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
24.asv: Now therefore, mysons, hearken unto me, And attend to the words of my mouth.

25.web: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
25.asv: Let not thy heart decline to her ways; Go not astray in her paths.

26.web: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
26.asv: For she hath cast down many wounded: Yea, all her slain are a mighty host.

27.web: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
27.asv: Her house is the way to Sheol, Going down to the chambers of death.
